---
title: "Programming with Python"
---

Python is a general-purpose programming language. Programs written in Python
are easy to read and understand. Python has simple, beginner-friendly syntax.
People in many fields, including science, engineering, astronomy, and biology,
use Python to automate tasks, analyse data, and solve problems.

![*Python*, [xkcd #353](https://xkcd.com/353/) by Randall Munroe, used under [CC BY-NC 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/2.5/)](/images/xkcd-353-python.png){fig-alt="One stick figure asks another how he is flying. The flying figure says that he learned Python and typed import antigravity."}

We'll start by learning how to run Python on your computer. We'll then work
through carefully crafted, bite-sized, hands-on lessons. Each lesson explains
one topic simply and ends with practice problems for you to try.

By the end of this unit, you'll be comfortable using Python to read and write
files, fetch data from APIs, and build command-line applications that automate
tedious tasks.

[Ready to get started?](using-python.qmd)
